Subject: Intro: SOC 2 evidence handoff + evaluation MAP & timeline

Hi Elena / Raj —

Thanks for taking time yesterday on the demo. As discussed, I wanted to introduce our internal GRC and SE points of contact and share a first‑pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) to keep the evaluation on a two‑week close cadence. The goal here is to make evidence handoff predictable and minimize back‑and‑forth during your SOC 2 review.

High level MAP (draft):
- Week 0 (now): introductions + confirm POCs and data handling contact (this thread) — due 10/29
- Week 1: Broad evidence drop (SOC 2 report, controls owner roster, data flow diagrams) — due 11/04
- Week 2: Technical sample access & verification (read‑only model run / logs) — due 11/11
- Week 3: Final clarifications + procurement/contract review — target close 11/18

Owner assignments (proposed):
- Evidence & SOC 2 report: Elena Morales / BrightLeaf GRC
- Data handling & lineage questions: Raj Patel / BrightLeaf Data Security
- Technical access & demo artifacts: Marcus Lin / Redwood SE (cc'd)
- Contracts & procurement: Laura Bennett / Redwood Sales Ops

Attachments: I attached a one‑page MAP and an evidence matrix template to use as a checklist. Marcus will follow up with the technical access checklist and a short runbook for providing artifacts.

Next steps: can you confirm the two POCs above (GRC and Data) and a 30‑minute sync on Thursday 10/29? I proposed two time windows in the Drive scheduling sheet (link below).

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
A: aisha.rahman@redwood.com | M: (415) 555‑0192

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_BrightLeaf_v1.xlsx, Evidence_Matrix_template.csv

Subject: Re: Intro: SOC 2 evidence handoff + evaluation MAP & timeline

Hi Aisha —

Thanks — this looks good and pragmatic. Confirming my team will be primary on evidence: I'll own the SOC 2 artifacts and control descriptions. Raj is the data handling POC and will handle DLP/data flow questions (he's cc'd).

We have a few internal constraints to flag up front: BrightLeaf keeps a quarterly evidence window for external access to production logs; for technical verification we may need a short lived read‑only environment or synthetic dataset. I'll attach our security inventory that highlights those constraints.

Thursday 10/29 at 10:00 AM PT works for Raj and me. Please send a calendar invite — Marcus, can you take the runbook items for the technical sample access?

Elena Morales
Head of GRC, BrightLeaf Therapeutics
elena.morales@brightleaf.com | +1 617 555 0124
